milestone: M49 Headless Mode Pack Update Drive

answers.strategic_capabilities: headless_autonomous_development with supporting mode_pack_runtime, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: Public headless.run.advance and headless.run.drive can carry existing typed Mode Pack provenance verification, approval, and replacement targets after selected-candidate fetch.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Direct headless.continue_once supports the later Mode Pack continuation targets, but durable public run-control exposed only registry-selection and selected-candidate fetch targets.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Scheduled callers would stall after fetch or need caller-owned continue_once route glue outside the run-session replay authority.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M49.1 selected-candidate fetch route-drive and M49.2 registry-to-fetch bootstrap plus fetch replay integrity.
answers.no_new_rpc: No new RPC is needed; existing headless.run.advance and headless.run.drive are expanded with bounded typed target fields.
answers.no_new_summary: No new summary surface is needed; the phase uses bounded run-control results and checkpoint replay evidence.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Run-control validates route-kind agreement, forwards later Mode Pack targets to existing continuation authority, and fails closed on routed replay evidence mismatch.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can keep the Mode Pack update chain inside Rust-owned durable session/drive authority.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the public run-control reachability gap for existing post-fetch Mode Pack update route boundaries.

exit_criteria: headless.run.advance can execute bounded provenance verification, approval, and replacement targets from matching persisted route boundaries
headless.run.drive can carry the same bounded targets through its first runtime-owned advance
routed replay for the later Mode Pack steps validates subordinate checkpoint request identity before returning replayed run-control evidence
wrong route, mixed target, stale progress, invalid budget, and raw payload attempts are rejected before side effects
no new RPC, generic route executor, report, readiness, history, digest, or fabricated rollback route kind is added
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior tests cover public headless.run.advance dispatch for provenance verification and approval after selected-candidate fetch
Rust behavior tests cover public headless.run.drive first-advance dispatch for selected approved candidate replacement
Rust replay tests cover missing and mismatched later Mode Pack targets before returning replayed run-control evidence
VSIX protocol tests validate run-control params with later typed targets and raw field rejection
